name: The University of New South Wales

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: The University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney) is a leading Australian university known for excellence in research and teaching, and consistently ranks among the top universities in the world. UNSW offers a broad range of undergraduate, postgraduate and specialisation courses across areas such as Arts & Social Sciences, Business, Engineering, Science, Law, Medicine & Health, Built Environment, Design and IT.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At UNSW, you’ll find numerous student clubs, societies, events, and cultural activities and celebrations throughout the year. The university also supports you with resources for wellbeing and academics.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
UNSW offers a variety of accommodation options. You can choose from on-campus colleges or apartments, which are located both on and off campus.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
UNSW’s library offers you extensive physical and digital collections, study spaces and more.

Sports
On campus, you’ll have access to a wide range of sporting facilities, fitness centres, classes and competitive clubs.

Laboratory
UNSW has many extensive, world-class research and teaching laboratories, particularly within the 7-storey Science and Engineering Building (SEB).

Cafeteria
UNSW has many on-campus dining options, including cafes and restaurants. Popular places to eat include The Point (AGSM), The Little Marionette (Clancy Kiosk), and more.
